uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
6495-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
6495-6972-8329--225.notes:
You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6798-7435--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

570-4091-7791.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {R}{G}{W}{U}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

2257-4508-7223.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2257-4508-7223.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Stalactite Dagger, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

575-2921-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

800-4116-7066.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Avatar Kyoshi.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least seven {U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-4499-7009.manaNeeded: {3} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-4499-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn

874-1170-1251-1329.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1251-1329.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2921-4336-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3781-4050-4215--124.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
3781-4050-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

2457-5794-6441-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

856-2034-2267-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2043-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Boommobile that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
When the Boommobile tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger, adding {12} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1270-2043-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1003-1329-1477-2178.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-1477-2178.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

914-1445-6281.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1445-6281.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dockside Extortionist, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Hashaton triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2187-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2187-2556-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Possessed Skaab.
When Mnemonic Wall and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-2556-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

5231-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5231-5805--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with persist, adding {R}.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Repeat.

1637-2573-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2529-3941-4067.notablePrerequisites: Vedalken Mastermind does not have summoning sickness.
2529-3941-4067.description:
Cast Coveted Jewel by paying {6}.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Vedalken Mastermind.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Coveted Jewel to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

4316-5004-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cathodion on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Cathodion from the top of your library by paying {3}.
Repeat.

824-4289-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a counter on it.
824-4289-4772.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a counter from a creature, and putting two of that type of counter on another target creature.
Repeat.

1165-1844-2861.notablePrerequisites: Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
1165-1844-2861.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying {3}{B}, causing you to draw four cards and give control of Archfiend of the Dross to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

59-147-1379-5256.description:
Cast Roar of Reclamation by paying {5}{W}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Roar of Reclamation.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing any player to mill two cards.
Resolve a copy of Roar of Reclamation, returning all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

262-1110-3332.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Deep-Slumber Titan.
Deep-Slumber Titan does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Deep-Slumber Titan indestructible.
262-1110-3332.description:
Give Deep-Slumber Titan indestructible, if needed.
Activate Deep-Slumber Titan by tapping it, creating seven 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to Deep-Slumber Titan.
Deep-Slumber Titan triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve all remaining Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 6 damage divided among any number of targets.
Repeat from step 2.

2128-4560-4697.notablePrerequisites: Permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U/R}{U/R}{U}{U}.
2128-4560-4697.description:
Activate any number of mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U/R}{U/R}{U}{U}.
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}, causing you to put the next instant or sorcery card you cast from your hand this turn into your hand as it resolves.
Cast Reality Spasm by paying a total of {U}{U} due to Hinata, untapping the mana-producing permanents and returning Reality Spasm to your hand due to Soulfire Grand Master.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this on each opponent's upkeep to first gain infinite mana, then repeat the loop using Reality Spasm's other mode instead to tap down all opponents' permanents.

1261-4993.description:
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1}, untapping Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
